---
title: DOCX figure captions and alt text (Jupyter)
format: docx
jupyter: python3
_quarto:
  tests:
    docx:
      ensureDocxXpath:
        -
          # cross-referenced cell
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='Figure\u00a01: J1 caption']"
          # unlabelled cell with fig-cap
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='J2 caption']"
          # fig-subcap with layout-ncol: both subcaptions and the panel caption
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='(a) J4a sub caption']"
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='(b) J4b sub caption']"
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='Figure\u00a02: J4 caption']"
          # cross-referenced cell without fig-alt
          - "//w:p[w:pPr/w:pStyle/@w:val='ImageCaption'][string-join(.//w:t, '')='Figure\u00a03: J5 caption']"
          # descr of a cross-referenced cell without fig-alt is empty
          - "//w:tbl[.//w:t[contains(., 'J5 caption')]]//wp:docPr[@descr='']"
          # descr of cells with fig-alt is that value
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='J1 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='J2 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='J3 ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='J4a ALT-ONLY']"
          - "//wp:docPr[@descr='J4b ALT-ONLY']"
        -
          # alt text never becomes visible text
          - "//w:t[contains(., 'ALT-ONLY')]"
          - "//w:tbl[.//w:t[contains(., 'J5 caption')]]//wp:docPr[@descr!='']"
---

Pins how figure captions and alt text from Jupyter cells render in DOCX.
Visible captions must stay unchanged whatever the filter pipeline does with alt text, and every alt value carries a marker that must never appear in the document text.
The image description (`descr`) is the `fig-alt` value when one is set, and empty for the cross-referenced cell without it.

```{python}
#| label: fig-j1
#| fig-cap: "J1 caption"
#| fig-alt: "J1 ALT-ONLY"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.plot([1, 2])
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "J2 caption"
#| fig-alt: "J2 ALT-ONLY"
plt.plot([1, 2])
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| fig-alt: "J3 ALT-ONLY"
plt.plot([1, 2])
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-j4
#| fig-cap: "J4 caption"
#| fig-subcap: ["J4a sub caption", "J4b sub caption"]
#| fig-alt: ["J4a ALT-ONLY", "J4b ALT-ONLY"]
#| layout-ncol: 2
plt.plot([1, 2])
plt.show()
plt.plot([2, 1])
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-j5
#| fig-cap: "J5 caption"
plt.plot([1, 2])
plt.show()
```
